name: mess-tokens
description: Fingerprint meal-token system for a mess (paid canteen)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,DASHBOARD,BRIDGE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:bridge"
